items.title: SaaStr Annual
items.description: The largest B2B SaaS conference globally. Keynotes and workshops on PLG, enterprise sales, fundraising, and product strategy from founders and VCs.

items.title: Mind the Product — ProductCon
items.description: Major product management conference with strong B2B tracks. Covers product discovery, strategy, leadership, and AI in product. Workshops and networking.
items.location: London / San Francisco / Singapore / New York

items.title: Product Hunt — GLITCH Conference
items.description: Conference focused on product launches, growth, and community building. B2B track covers SaaS launches, developer products, and PLG distribution strategies.

items.title: Business of Software Conference
items.description: Long-running conference for B2B SaaS founders and product leaders. Focus on profitable growth, bootstrapping, pricing, and product strategy without VC dependency.

items.title: Reforge Huddle
items.description: Exclusive gathering for senior product and growth leaders. Deep dives on B2B retention, enterprise activation funnels, and product-led expansion. Application-based attendance.

items.title: PDMA Annual Conference — Product Development & Management Association
items.description: Academic and practitioner conference on product development. Strong B2B and industrial product track. Covers NPD processes, portfolio management, and innovation metrics.

items.title: SaaStock
items.description: European B2B SaaS conference with focus on growth, metrics, and international expansion. Strong B2B community and investor presence.

items.title: Product-Led Summit
items.description: The premier PLG conference. Sessions on product-qualified leads, freemium strategy, user onboarding, and expansion revenue. B2B SaaS focus.

items.title: Enterprise Product Summit
items.description: Niche conference for product managers working on enterprise-grade B2B products. Covers compliance, security reviews, multi-tenant architecture, and enterprise sales engineering.

items.title: Intercom — What's New Conference
items.description: Customer communication and product-led growth conference. Covers conversational support, in-app messaging, product tours, and user engagement for B2B SaaS.
